faq.q: What is the Cekat.AI HR solution?
faq.a: An AI agent answering candidate and employee questions from your policy knowledge base, a shared inbox for the HR team, segmented announcement broadcasts, and automatic escalation for sensitive topics.
Yes. The AI answers applicant questions about requirements and process, reminds candidates of interview schedules via broadcast, and organizes candidates in a pipeline from screening to offer.

faq.q: How does the AI know our company policies?
faq.a: From the documents you upload: company regulations, benefit guides, SOPs, or internal FAQs. The AI answers only from those sources, and you can update them anytime.
You define the list of topics that always go to a human, salary and personal issues for example. The AI does not answer them; it hands over to the HR team with the chat history.

faq.q: Can we broadcast announcements to employees?
faq.a: Yes, segmented by division, location, or status. Sent through the official WhatsApp Business API with approved templates, with read rates you can measure.
WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, and live chat on your careers page, all landing in the same HR inbox.

faq.q: How long until it is usable?
faq.a: A first bot is live in about 5 minutes with no code. Uploading policy documents and setting escalation rules is usually done the same day.

faq.q: Can several HR staff share one number?
faq.a: Yes. Through the WhatsApp Business API, one HR number is served by several staff at once with clean conversation assignment, so no employee chat gets double-handled or missed entirely.
